requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: TLS-verified first-party page returned HTTP 200. It identifies بوابة السودان المكانية (Sudan Spatial Portal), says it is a national interactive spatial-map portal, and explicitly describes OGC WMS and WFS services. The page links to https://www.geoportal.gov.sd/. No parcel layer URL, schema, native ID, CRS, or feature response was exposed in the retrieved HTML.

Direct TLS-verified curl could not resolve the host from this environment (DNS error). The web retrieval tool also reported the URL as inaccessible. No retry with disabled TLS, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or guessed endpoints was attempted.

First-party discovery returned the official Arabic land-registration description; direct curl returned HTTP 521 from the host. The published content describes registration offices, surveying/settlement, and registration using an approved map or sketch. It does not provide an anonymous parcel-vector endpoint or Ed Al Fursan geometry.

TLS-verified curl returned HTTP 502 and the web retrieval tool could read the public landing page from cache. The page identifies Aqari as a Sudan Judiciary national electronic land/real-estate registration platform and advertises land-record review, search certificates, and subdivision services. No anonymous parcel map, safe native ID, schema, CRS, or geometry response was exposed; no login was attempted.
